items.title: Add proof surface inventory docs and machine-readable surface map
items.context: Covers plan M0. Inventory current proof-looking surfaces, producer boundaries, binding fields, artifact consumers, and evidence scope. Must include candidate-only Repro artifacts from B-0aa1 and non-authority/local diagnostic surfaces.
items.userSees: User sees docs/evidence/proof-surface-inventory.md and .json listing each proof-looking surface with scope, producer boundary, consumers, and whether productionDone is allowed.

happy.desc: Inventory includes every M0 surface named in the plan, including done-required evidence, delivery/review artifacts, Authority receipt refs, local diagnostics, handoff, local quorum, and B-0aa1 Repro candidate artifacts.

edge.desc: Inventory explicitly marks non-production scopes such as evidence-candidate, local-diagnostic, local-key-single-host, authority-receipt, and legacy-observed as unable to set productionDone.

adversarial.desc: A reader cannot confuse raw Repro candidate, local diagnostic Authority status, or authority-receipt-only evidence with production-gate-decision proof.

verificationEvidence.note: Inventory docs and JSON include M0 surfaces, B-0aa1 candidate artifacts, scopes, producer boundaries, consumers, and productionDone eligibility.
Negative controls deny production claims for evidence-candidate, local-diagnostic, local-key-single-host, local-review-quorum, authority-receipt-only, and legacy surfaces.
Docs and smoke distinguish raw authority-receipt from gate-consumed production-gate-decision.

items.title: Implement shared proof admissibility domain and registry
items.context: Covers plan M1. Add core module/types for EvidenceScope, TemporalRole, ArtifactRole, ClaimKind, ArtifactConsumerKind, ProofProducerBoundary, reason codes, artifact definitions, and classification result. Must be reusable by future gates and must not create a separate storage root.
items.userSees: User sees a shared proof admissibility registry in core code with canonical scopes, roles, consumers, claims, temporal roles, producer boundaries, and reason codes.

happy.desc: The core registry exposes canonical EvidenceScope, ArtifactRole, ClaimKind, ArtifactConsumerKind, TemporalRole, ProofProducerBoundary, and stable reason-code types.

edge.desc: Unknown artifact kinds and unsupported schema/scope combinations fail closed with structured reason codes rather than defaulting to strong proof.

adversarial.desc: authority-receipt and production-gate-decision remain distinct registry entries with different productionDone eligibility.

verificationEvidence.note: Core registry exports canonical EvidenceScope, ArtifactRole, ClaimKind, ArtifactConsumerKind, TemporalRole, ProofProducerBoundary, and reason-code dictionaries.
Smoke asserts unknown artifact kinds and unsupported schema versions fail closed with structured reasons.
Smoke asserts authority-receipt and production-gate-decision are distinct, with productionDone eligibility only for the matching production gate decision.

items.title: Add classification/evaluation helper for proof-looking artifacts
items.context: Provide a caller-facing API that answers what a surface may prove, whether it is admissible for a consumer/claim, and why not. Include productionDone=false behavior for local diagnostic, candidate, local-key, authority-receipt without matching production gate decision, and legacy scopes.
items.userSees: User sees classifier results that say allowed=false with stable reason codes for candidate, diagnostic, legacy, local-key, and receipt-only inputs, and allowed=true only for matching production-gate-decision policy.

happy.desc: A matching production-gate-decision artifact can be classified as admissible for DONE production-readiness under its allowed policy.

edge.desc: local-review-quorum can satisfy local review escalation but cannot set productionDone or Authority completion claims.

adversarial.desc: local diagnostic accepted=true, raw Repro candidate, legacy observed evidence, local-key bundle, and authority-receipt without gate decision all deny production claims with explicit reason codes.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke verifies a matching authority-receipt-ref production-gate-decision is allowed and productionDoneEligible for production-completion.
Smoke verifies local-review-quorum can satisfy REVIEW review-pass while denying DONE/AUTHORITY production-completion.
Smoke verifies local diagnostic, raw candidate, legacy, local-key, and authority-receipt-only inputs deny production claims with explicit reason codes.

items.title: Add smoke tests and process fact registration for admissibility classification
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage for accepted/denied scopes, stale/material binding cases where applicable, local diagnostic overread prevention, candidate-only Repro surfaces, and registry completeness. Register any new command/task/runtime fact needed by the process fact contract.
items.userSees: User sees `proof-admissibility smoke passed`, process fact verification stays green, and the new test command is available from package scripts.

happy.desc: `npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility` prints `proof-admissibility smoke passed` after build.

edge.desc: `node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs` remains green after registering any new command/process fact introduced by this story.

adversarial.desc: Smoke includes negative controls proving non-production scopes cannot satisfy productionDone and missing/unknown definitions fail closed.
